name: com.paint-by-number/paint-by-numbers
title: Paint by Numbers Generator
description: Turn any photo into a printable paint-by-numbers template with a numbered colour key.

tools.name: create_paint_by_numbers
tools.description: Convert a photo (pet, family, wedding, landscape...) into a paint-by-numbers template. Returns: the numbered outline to paint on, a colour preview of the finished painting, a numbered colour key, and download links (printable SVG and PNG, valid for 30 days). Takes about 5 to 40 seconds.

image.description: Public http(s) URL of the photo (JPEG, PNG or WebP), or a data: URI / base64 data.

detail.description: simple = 12 colours, big regions (kids, beginners). medium = 16 colours. detailed = 24 colours, small regions (adults, realistic).

number_of_colors.description: Override the number of paint colours.

min_region_size.description: Override: remove regions smaller than this many pixels. Bigger = easier to paint.

palette.description: Use only these paints, as "#rrggbb" or {name, color}. Each colour snaps to the nearest paint.

color_space.description: lab can match human colour perception better.

outline_color.description: Line colour of the outline, e.g. #999999 for light lines.

tools.name: get_photo_upload_link
tools.description: Get a web page link where the person can upload a photo from their phone or computer. The page then shows an image URL to paste back into the chat, for use with create_paint_by_numbers. Use this when the photo is only on the person's device.

tools.name: order_custom_kit
tools.description: Get the links to buy a paint-by-numbers of the person's own photo from paint-by-number.com: the complete kit (pre-printed canvas, numbered pre-mixed paints and brushes, delivered) or the $9.99 printable PDF kit (print at home, own paints). Use when the person wants to paint the result for real, wants a gift, or asks where to buy.
